dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お、もうひとりの朝倉妹だな」
dialogues.en: "Ah, this must be another sister of yours."
dialogues.text: "Ah, this must be another sister of yours."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだそりゃ」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「文字通りそのまんまだろうが」
dialogues.en: "Exactly what I said."
dialogues.text: "Exactly what I said."

dialogues.jp:
今日の昼飯について語り合っていた杉並が、教
室の入り口を示す。
dialogues.en:
Suginami was talking about lunch, but now he's pointing at
the classroom door.
dialogues.text:
Suginami was talking about lunch, but now he's pointing at
the classroom door.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「やほ〜、はろ〜、お昼だよ〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Yoo-hoo! It's lunch time!"
dialogues.text: "Yoo-hoo! It's lunch time!"

dialogues.jp:
そんなさくらの声に首を曲げようとして――ふ
と、クラスの男子数人も一緒に顔を動かしてい
るのを見た。
dialogues.en:
As I turn towards Sakura, I notice other boys in my class
lifting their heads as well.
dialogues.text:
As I turn towards Sakura, I notice other boys in my class
lifting their heads as well.

dialogues.jp:
それは、声を聞いたから何気なく顔を上げた
――というのではなく、なにか別のオーラを
かもし出しているような……。
dialogues.en:
I think they look up not just because they heard her voice,
but also they saw some kind of aura from her.
dialogues.text:
I think they look up not just because they heard her voice,
but also they saw some kind of aura from her.

dialogues.jp:
「……なぁさくら、お前よく可愛いって言われ
　るか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Sakura. Has anybody told you you're cute?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Sakura. Has anybody told you you're cute?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ！？　なにそれ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What do you mean?"

dialogues.jp: ぴょん、とリボンを逆立ててさくらが身をひく。
dialogues.en: The bow in Sakura's hair bounces as she walks.
dialogues.text: The bow in Sakura's hair bounces as she walks.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、じゃあやっぱり呼び方なのかな……」
dialogues.en: "Then it must be what you call me."
dialogues.text: "Then it must be what you call me."

dialogues.jp:
果たして“お兄ちゃん”という言葉には、どれ
ほどの魔力と破壊力が秘められているのだろう。
dialogues.en:
I wonder how much power of magic and destruction the word
'oniichan' could have.
dialogues.text:
I wonder how much power of magic and destruction the word
'oniichan' could have.

dialogues.jp:
もしかして俺は、とんでもなく美味しい言葉に
聞き慣れてしまっているのか？
dialogues.en:
Have I started to take it for granted, hearing this sweet
word?
dialogues.text:
Have I started to take it for granted, hearing this sweet
word?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉。お前の悩みは分かるが、つね日ごろか
　ら兄さん、お兄ちゃんと言われているお前で
　は答えは出せないだろうさ」
dialogues.en:
"Junichi, I understand what you're feeling, but I think you
won't find the answer for it, because you're the one who's
been called 'niisan' or 'oniichan' all the time."
dialogues.text:
"Junichi, I understand what you're feeling, but I think you
won't find the answer for it, because you're the one who's
been called 'niisan' or 'oniichan' all the time."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そうか？　……つーか、お前に悩みを見透か
　されたことが凄くいやなんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"Really? ...What I don't like is that you've started trying
to solve my problems."
dialogues.text:
"Really? ...What I don't like is that you've started trying
to solve my problems."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「では、実験してみようか？」
dialogues.en: "Well, let's try an experiment."
dialogues.text: "Well, let's try an experiment."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なんだか分からないけどご飯買いに行こう
　よぉ。美味しいの売り切れちゃうよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Whatever it is, let's go buy lunch now. They'll run out of
good food soon."
dialogues.text:
"Whatever it is, let's go buy lunch now. They'll run out of
good food soon."

dialogues.jp:
制服の｛すそ／裾｝をひっぱって、さくらが無警戒な――
いわゆる、いじめて光線を発している瞳で俺を
見上げる。
dialogues.en:
Pulling the sleeve of my uniform, Sakura glances up at me
with a naive look - I mean with sparkling eyes.
dialogues.text:
Pulling the sleeve of my uniform, Sakura glances up at me
with a naive look - I mean with sparkling eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「芳乃嬢、今日の朝倉はその程度の破壊力では
　ついてきてくれないぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Sakura-sama, I should tell you Asakura won't play along any
more with your destructive power."
dialogues.text:
"Sakura-sama, I should tell you Asakura won't play along any
more with your destructive power."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いつもいつも『お兄ちゃん』ではマンネリと
　いうものだ」
dialogues.en:
"He said he won't respond to you unless you call him
something special to make him hot."
dialogues.text:
"He said he won't respond to you unless you call him
something special to make him hot."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃにゃ！？」
dialogues.en: "Hmmmhh?!"
dialogues.text: "Hmmmhh?!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「杉並……その説明はどうかと思うぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, Suginami, I don't know if it's a good idea to tell her
like that."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, Suginami, I don't know if it's a good idea to tell her
like that."

dialogues.jp:
杉並は制服のポケットからなにかメモのような
物を取り出して、真剣に見つめている。
dialogues.en:
They don't care what I'm feeling, and now they're talking
over a bit of paper without me.
dialogues.text:
They don't care what I'm feeling, and now they're talking
over a bit of paper without me.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……まずは、朝倉妹の真似で！」
dialogues.en:
"If you want to go for something simple, you should call him
'aniue', or 'anikun', which is in fashion now."
dialogues.text:
"If you want to go for something simple, you should call him
'aniue', or 'anikun', which is in fashion now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「え？　え？　あう……“兄さん、ハンカチは
　持った？”」
dialogues.en: "How about 'oniitama' or 'niichama'?"
dialogues.text: "How about 'oniitama' or 'niichama'?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「次はいつもよりもっとロリィに！」
dialogues.en: "I wouldn't recommend those for someone like you."
dialogues.text: "I wouldn't recommend those for someone like you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「え、えと……“お兄ちゃぁ〜ん。どこいっちゃ
　ったのぉ〜さくらをひとりにしないで……”」
dialogues.en: "Check?"
dialogues.text: "Check?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「次はもっとセクシーに！」
dialogues.en:
"That is part of the set. You have to use it with one of the
others, but it's way beyond your level."
dialogues.text:
"That is part of the set. You have to use it with one of the
others, but it's way beyond your level."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「せ、せくしー？！」

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「兄を誘惑する小悪魔的魅力で！」
dialogues.en:
I have an urge to listen to what they're saying, but also I
don't wanna hear anything...
dialogues.text:
I have an urge to listen to what they're saying, but also I
don't wanna hear anything...

dialogues.jp:
これ以上こいつらに関わっていると、貴重な昼
休みをものすごく無駄にしそうな気がする。
dialogues.en: Yeah, let's get out here.
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's get out here.

dialogues.jp: というわけで、速やかに逃走するに限る。
dialogues.en: It's too dangerous to stay here in many ways.
dialogues.text: It's too dangerous to stay here in many ways.

dialogues.jp:
俺は足音に細心の注意を払いつつ、教室のドア
に手をかける。
dialogues.en:
I place my hand on the classroom doorknob, trying not to
make a sound.
dialogues.text:
I place my hand on the classroom doorknob, trying not to
make a sound.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あ、あは♪　そっかな。なんだかボクもだん
　だん楽しくなってきちゃったよ」
dialogues.en: "How about this?"
dialogues.text: "How about this?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en:
"That one... Hm... If you use it right, that one could be
super-destructive."
dialogues.text:
"That one... Hm... If you use it right, that one could be
super-destructive."

dialogues.jp: そ〜っと扉を閉める。

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よし！　次は体育会系で！」
dialogues.en: I close the door quietly.
dialogues.text: I close the door quietly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「押忍ッ！　アニキ！　昼飯をご一緒させて欲
　しいっス！」
dialogues.en: "What? Aniya~, aniya~, where are you?"
dialogues.text: "What? Aniya~, aniya~, where are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「気が済むまでやってくれ。俺は知らん」
dialogues.en: "Waaaa!"
dialogues.text: "Waaaa!"

dialogues.jp:
当初の目的をすっかり忘れて盛り上がる二人を
残して、俺はひとりとぼとぼと歩いていった。
dialogues.en: I run away from there at full speed, covering my ears.
dialogues.text: I run away from there at full speed, covering my ears.

dialogues.jp: ◆お兄ちゃんと呼ばれて◆
dialogues.en: ◆Aniya~◆
dialogues.text: ◆Aniya~◆

dialogues.jp:
呼ばれ慣れているので気付かなかったが、「お
兄ちゃん」という呼び方には、相当破壊力があ
るようだ。
dialogues.en:
Suginami tried to convince Sakura of the crazy idea that the
way she calls me 'oniichan' is out of fashion.
dialogues.text:
Suginami tried to convince Sakura of the crazy idea that the
way she calls me 'oniichan' is out of fashion.

dialogues.jp:
しかも杉並のやつがさくらに色々なバリエーショ
ンを吹き込もうとする。
dialogues.en:
I got out of the classroom quietly because I didn't want her
to call me absurd things.
dialogues.text:
I got out of the classroom quietly because I didn't want her
to call me absurd things.

dialogues.jp: 俺はそっと教室から逃げ出したのだった。
dialogues.en: "Oniicha~n!"
dialogues.text: "Oniicha~n!"
